title: [Pre Order, PC] World of Warcraft: Forever Collector's Edition $219.95 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Pre Order, PC] World of Warcraft: Forever Collector's Edition $219.95 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[mikeybob] As someone who missed out on both the pre orders from EB and JB, thank you so much! Been keen to get this <3
[RAVTagsta] Love to hear this! Not only it is amazing for many to get a chance to buy it, but when I was talking to the chat support guy, such a pleasant surprise to hear that its the first batch.
[dmurton] Does it let you play forever without a subscription…
[MasterScythe] Unlikely. It was $16.50 a month when i last played.
My mate played for a literal decade longer and I think he was paying a flat $20.
No idea what it is now.
[belongsinforums] then it's not really warcraft 'forever' is it?
[geekboy] An active subscription is required, just like Classic.
[Alcaro] Doesn't instill confidence them touting immersion breaking mini-pets as part of the CE. Anyone know if you can toggle them off?
[Nalar] Day one of vanilla and I had a mini diablo and zergling following me around…..so I reckon it'll be fine.
[rekkore] Not available , it's giving 'no longer available from seller' error
[Ten] This is where you click Report, then Expired/Sold out so that it gets marked as such.
[rekkore] Gauging whether it's a me problem or an everyone problem but okay 🤙
[RAVTagsta] Na not just you, I marked as OOS - it looks like I may have stumbled on a few leftovers/cancellations from the first wave. It went OOS a few mins before your comment I think
[MrZ] A physical PC release?? Blizzard must be the only company still doing this. Does it contain DVD-ROMs? Or a USB?
[The Value] It's only contains landfill.
They stopped releasing games on disc a few years ago.
[MrZ] Also, aren't these collector's editions normally $199.95? That's what Midnight was going for when it first came out.
[The Value] Missed out again while there's 30+ listings on eBay!
[Benoffie] Really think they need to introduce a lotto system to stop scalpers/resellers.
They wont but it needs to happen.
[brotherfranciz] I cancelled my JBHIFI preorder for $232 as it was for the February/March backorder.
Well, at least you know there's 1 backorder available at JB Hi-Fi… (No but seriously, thanks to OP for not being selfish/scalping).
[Dogstar] Check if you're still after one. I just got a one a few minutes ago.
[Fredfloresjr] OzRRP angry mobs, why so quiet with this One?
[CptnObvious] The classic game takes them back to their adolescence, when they weren't so miserable.
[misunderstood98] This game gives me a weird feeling… I was tempted to join it for it, but it's had so much social media presence, both from influencers and the AI bot farms.
The extreme amount of AI slop and underhanded marketing to promote this game has gotten it to the point that approx every 2nd or 3rd post or ad in my algorithm keeps shoving it down my throat.
It has actually turned me off playing, and was probably the nail in the coffin for any blizz/activision games.
[Dogstar] I just got one around 10:40pm so if anyone missed out earlier, check again.
It also says "Quantity limit met for this seller." so it seems you can only buy one.
[silverduck22] For those who are still awake or heading out for a workout like myself… It just got back in stock and I grabbed one for myself.
